Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Whidbey Cast-Aluminum Dining Arm Chair, Set of 2
Materials: Aluminum
2 all-weather dining arm chairs for outdoor use Made of durable, yet lightweight, cast aluminum; elegant multi-step hand finish Scrolling lattice motif design on back; coordinates with Whidbey dining collection Includes seat cushions with 100-percent Olefin covers and Velcro loops to secure Each chair measures 26 inches long by 25 inches wide by 36 inches high Rust Free Cast Aluminum Frame UV Protected Olefin Fabric Elegant Multi-Step Hand Finish
